title: Every frame you see was written in code. No AI images, no camera.
title_candidates: Claude built every frame of this film using pure code, no images
Every frame you see was written in code. No AI images, no camera.
A 3-minute film where Claude coded every visual from scratch
What happens when you ask AI to make a film without using any images
The film about AI history where every single visual was built by writing code
caption:
This 3-minute film about AI history was built frame by frame in code. No camera, no AI image tools, no stock footage. Just Claude writing code.

It starts with the paper that launched modern AI, "Attention Is All You Need," and ends at AGI. Every visual, every transition, every scene was generated by code, not an image generator.

One person, one prompt, and a Claude coding session.
